name: Shared Hope
whoFor: Refugees in Kirklees aged 18 and over who are not working or looking for work and face barriers such as trauma, poor mental health, isolation or limited English, and want support with wellbeing, settling in and moving towards work.
eligibility: Economically inactive (not working and not looking for work)
Has the right to work in the UK
Has a health condition or disability
gate: Is economically inactive (not working and not looking for work)
Has the right to work in the UK
referralRoutes: Self-referral: contact Shared Goods Charity by phone or email (contact: Christina Simpkin)

selfReferral.note: Contact Shared Goods Charity directly by phone or email

projects.name: Shared Hope
projects.overview: A face-to-face pre-employment programme for refugees facing several barriers to settling in, wellbeing and work, including trauma, poor mental health, social isolation and limited English. Each person gets tailored support.
projects.duration: Six months, about 40 hours of tailored support each. Runs 1 October 2026 to 31 March 2027, 10 places

notes: Status before November 2026: Live - six-month programme for 10 people, 1 October 2026 to 31 March 2027

provenance.source: HWL grant-funded scheme details supplied by the programme team, row 20 (2 November 2026)
provenance.evidence: Eligibility set to the Healthy Working Life grant funding criteria by the programme team (2 November 2026): Kirklees resident, economically inactive, right to work in the UK, health condition or disability, 18+ unless the scheme says otherwise.
